research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: frozen/indexed APH, current MP biography, Fabians speaker biography, 2015 ABC appointment report, public professional-index and early-work searches. Old biography URL unavailable; APH returned 403. Full-time/hospitality searches yielded no verified additional employment.

Obtain archived original biography and staff appointment evidence for Travers/Parke/Rudd; resolve Travers 2006–07 versus 2008 conflict, Rudd title/office changes and gaps. Verify whether any early retail/hospitality or other paid work exists; absence is not zero.

Obtain United Voice and WA Labor exact payroll dates/hours/leave and 2018 resignation; separate paid secretary role from voluntary party governance. Resolve qualification dates, study/work overlap and any career breaks. Political, party and union roles remain excluded regardless of funding or full-time status.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: full first-speech text on own website recovered after APH restricted-URL failure and identifies McDonalds shift management, overturning earlier unsuccessful hospitality search. Two Guild primary pages establish Humanities Representative 2004 and full-time president 2005; pay still unknown.

Distinguished three-month leave reported before Parliament in 2018 from separate three-month leave ending around March 2021; neither assigned invented day boundaries. May 2018 secretary handover supported by Dixon succession account, not July election proxy.

Targeted early-job, union, staff and public professional searches still leave Travers date conflict and hospitality dates/outlet/entity unresolved. US restaurant, cybersecurity and recruitment namesakes excluded. DEWR McDonalds keyword hit was an unrelated recommended Tony Burke interview, not Gorman employment evidence. Next: Guild 2005 remuneration/annual report, McDonalds outlet and dates, original staff appointments and union payroll.

Follow-up2026-10-04: New Guild interview records earlier 2003 Council membership and Curtin enrolment; preserved separate 2004/2005 roles and unknown study completion/work overlap. Targeted McDonalds outlet, Travers appointment and 2005 remuneration searches did not close private-work date/hour gaps. Curtin tabled annual-report index contains 13 August 2005 cessation for a university elected representative; two report opens returned HTTP403, so do not apply that date to Guild presidency or payroll. Future avenue: inspect full 2004/2005 university reports for separate governance membership, with no assumption it was salaried.

Follow-up2026-10-05: PrimaryCurtin2005reportp13 indexed full governance context now distinguishes separate undergraduate UniversityCouncil membership until13August2005; recorded separately from Guildpresidency, no FTstaff attribution. Tabledpaper1409dated12April2006corroboratesreportyear despite2004-5filename. Two ordinarypublic opens403, no access bypass; localrequests module absence recoveredurllib.
